designationHistory.name: Upper Klamath Wild Life Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Calvin Coolidge established the Upper Klamath Wild Life Refuge by Executive Order 4851 on April 3, 1928 on 7,560 acres of reclamation lands.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (2016 CCP: Coolidge reserved 7,560 acres as the Upper Klamath Wild Life Refuge by EO 4851, April 3, 1928) and Pass B (Monthly Catalog entry for EO 4851 dated April 3, 1928; Oregon Assistant Attorney General memo quoting the order) agree. Renamed Upper Klamath National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.
